sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Customer_Addresses"."customer_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Customer_Addresses" GROUP BY "Customer_Addresses"."customer_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
why: gap to the all average of number of Customer_Addresses records (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Product_Suppliers"."supplier_id" AS e, AVG("Product_Suppliers"."total_amount_purchased") AS m1, SUM("Product_Suppliers"."total_value_purchased") AS m2 FROM "Product_Suppliers" GROUP BY "Product_Suppliers"."supplier_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
why: average of quantity of product purchased per Suppliers (by supplier_id)
total of value of product purchased per Suppliers (by supplier_id) (additive)
gap to the all average of total of value of product purchased (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
